generations.name: First generation (G70)
generations.notes: Launch. 105.7 kWh gross / 101.7 kWh usable pack, up to 195 kW DC, 400 V class. xDrive60 from MY2023, eDrive50 and M70 from MY2024. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_7_Series_(G70)

generations.name: 2027 update (Gen6 cells)
generations.notes: LCI: new 112.5 kWh pack with Gen6 cylindrical cells (developed with Rimac) on the existing CLAR platform, DC peak up from 195 to 250 kW, 10-80 % in about 28 minutes; models renamed xDrive50 / xDrive60 (EPA 2027 rows). Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/793634/2027-bmw-i7-neue-klasse-more-range-faster-charging/ ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2026/04/22/2027-bmw-7-series-i7-debut/
